body: We do not sell your personal information. We disclose information only to the services needed to deliver this site and its enabled features, including the providers identified below and the database, payment or email providers named above where they apply.
We do not use submitted contact, booking or order details to advertise to you elsewhere.
bodyZh: 我們不出售你的個人資料。只有在傳送本站與已啟用功能所必需時，才會向服務商揭露資料；包括下文所列供應商，以及（在適用時）上述的資料庫、付款或郵件服務商。
我們不會用你送出的聯絡、預約或訂單資料在其他地方對你投放廣告。

sections.hZh: 你的瀏覽器會連線的服務
body: · The web host receives ordinary request data needed to deliver each page, such as your IP address, browser or device information, the requested URL and request time. Host security and access logs may retain that data.

· Every page downloads its selected typefaces from Google Fonts. Your browser therefore contacts Google and sends ordinary request data such as your IP address, browser information and the font files requested.
· Pages with a map contact Google Maps. Google receives ordinary request data and the business-place query needed to render the map.
bodyZh: · 主機商會收到傳送每個頁面所必需的一般請求資料，例如你的 IP 位址、瀏覽器或裝置資訊、請求網址與請求時間。主機的安全與存取紀錄可能會保留這些資料。
· 每個頁面都會從 Google Fonts 下載所選字型。因此你的瀏覽器會連線到 Google，並傳送 IP 位址、瀏覽器資訊與所請求字型檔等一般請求資料。
· 含有地圖的頁面會連線到 Google Maps。Google 會收到一般請求資料，以及顯示地圖所需的店家地點查詢。

body: We keep business records for as long as we need them to run the business and to meet tax and accounting obligations, and then we delete them. The web host and browser-delivered providers may separately retain security, access or measurement logs under their own retention settings and policies.
bodyZh: 我們保留業務紀錄的期間，以經營所需與稅務、會計法規要求為限，之後即予刪除。主機商與瀏覽器載入的服務商，可能另依其保留設定與政策保存安全、存取或衡量紀錄。
